correctness.rationale: Every NC5 partition, proper refinement flag, tenfold Kreweras orbit simplex, quotient attaching word and 74 homotopy-preserving single-generator two-cell cancellations are recreated and checked by the included standalone verifier and certificate. Contracting a 35-edge spanning tree leaves one loop and one attaching word of exponent five. The identification of quotient orbit cells uses barycentric subdivision and an inversion-free finite action; 36/110/75 cell counts and modular boundary ranks independently confirm the chain structure.

originality.rationale: The known five-point rotation and pentagonal dihedral relabeling quotients, as well as the published nonequivariant, cyclic-sieving and orbit-enumeration theorems, neither identify nor imply the attaching words of the order-ten Kreweras-complement quotient. A complete finite cancellation certificate proves the new homotopy type. An unindexed equivalent theorem remains possible.
residual_risks: No proof of global publication priority: a general theorem or equivalent result could be unindexed or inaccessible.
The external exact NC5/C5 prior calculation is used only to compare scope; the Kreweras cancellation certificate establishes the finding independently.

value.rationale: Kreweras complement is a canonical order-reversing duality on noncrossing partition lattices. Unlike the rank-preserving fivefold rotations and dihedral label symmetries on the same natural 2-complex, its entire tenfold action produces the pure order-five Moore space, killing the two additional free spheres while retaining first homology torsion. This gives a complete natural finite homotopy classification with nontrivial attaching degree, not a routine Betti count or an arbitrary subfamily.
